[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]1)[/b] [/color]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]5)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains two folders one with content.json, & manifest.json, and another folder with shops.json & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP & STF] Cooking and Crafting Recipes for Sale/[CP] Cooking and Crafting Recipes for Sale"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]7)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]




[/font][u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776467-497634449.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/u]
[font=Arial][size=2][size=2]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.4, 1.5.5 and 1.5.6 [/size]CONFIRMED[size=2]. Probably works with earlier versions as well but I haven't tested it with anything less than 1.5.4.[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Windows and macOS (I have not tested it on Linux but I don't see why it wouldn't work there too)[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Single-player and Multiplayer.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
-No mod [b]conflicts[/b] that I know of yet.
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=2][b]
-Issues [/b]may arise if you have any other mods installed that LOAD the same files. [/size][/font]
